label: Episode 13
logline: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 12's climax where Juliana demanded to know where the frozen blackthorn garden was located to save Alexander from the gallows.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 13, 1 segment(s), 22s
[01:37.00-01:43.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.
[01:38.20-01:42.50] JULIANA (Panting, Praying): "Please, ring... you have to be here."
[01:43.00-01:46.50] ACTION: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
[01:43.00-01:47.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
[01:47.00-01:49.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.
[01:49.00-01:52.00] ACTION: Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.
[01:49.00-01:52.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of her bloody hand closing around the emerald signet ring.
[01:52.00-01:53.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana grimacing in fierce triumph and intense pain as thorns catch her knuckles.
[01:53.00-01:54.00] CAMERA: Brief cut to Alexander staring into the briar patch in suspended terror.
[01:54.00-01:57.20] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's sweat- and frost-streaked face as she grinds her teeth, tears pooling in her eyes, fighting through the blinding pain.
[01:57.20-01:58.88] CAMERA: Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.

[00:50.00-00:53.00] ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.

[00:51.50-00:52.60] ALEXANDER (Strangled, Weeping): "Please..."
[00:52.00-00:53.50] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.
[00:53.50-00:56.00] CAMERA: Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
[00:54.00-00:56.50] ACTION: Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.
[00:54.50-00:55.80] JULIANA (Gasping in Pain): "No..."
[00:56.00-00:58.20] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.
[00:57.20-00:58.60] CLARISSA (Gleeful, Derisive): "Look at her hands."
